AGENDA
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
  NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  JULY 6, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN THE ZOOME MEETING BY
CALLING: (669) 900-6833; OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685 DURING THE MEETING
TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS
CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-
hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  REGULAR MEETING
  VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE
  6:00 P.M.

  Jennifer Perez, Chair
  Tony Ayala, Vice Chair
  Rick Ramirez, Board Member
  Margarita L. Rios, Board Member
  Ana Valencia, Board Member

  Public Comment: See above.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain
  emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for
  consideration at a future City Council meeting

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
  services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the
  agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours
  prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made
  to provide participation in the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Agency regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted
  will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular
  business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720.
  You may also contact the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 CALL TO ORDER  Chair Perez

ROLL CALL  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  Secretary

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll
call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by the
Agency.

1. MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends the Agency approve the minutes of the regular meeting
  of June 1, 2021.  1305-03

2. WARRANTS - Staff recommends the Agency approve the warrant register for the period May 27,
  2021 – June 30, 2021, in the total amount of $55,937.50.  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on
the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated this 2nd day of July 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
Secretary

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA
  JUNE 1, 2021

Chair Perez called the regular meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. via videoconference
pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-35-20.
Responding to roll call were Board Members Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia and Chair
Perez. Vice Chair Ayala was absent. Also present were Jesus M. Gomez, Agency
Counsel; John Lam Agency Assistant Counsel; and Theresa Devoy, Secretary.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one
motion and roll call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and
considered separately by the Agency. Boardmember Rios moved and Board Member
Ramirez seconded to approve the consent calendar as recommended. MOTION
CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Board Members Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia and Chair Perez
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  Vice Chair Ayala

MEETING MINUTES

The Agency approved the minutes of the regular meeting of April 6, 2021.  1305-03

WARRANTS

The Agency approved the warrant registers for the periods April 1, 2021 – April 28,
2021, in the total amount of $54,937.50 and April 29, 2021 – May 26, 2021, in the total
amount of $55,971  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

None.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no persons wishing to address the Agency.

  318

Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency
June 1, 2021

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business to come before the Agency, the meeting was adjourned
at 6:01 p.m.

  ___________________________
  THERESA DEVOY, CMC
